history.title: Ask Kova works through big requests: it shows each step as it happens, never gives up while the hub is still working, finds the answer after the app was closed, says honestly what didn’t work, and names the AI that answered

A design pass: alerts on Now as clear cards with Open, Not now and That’s expected as buttons; a calmer Security page with the home’s status first; nothing cut off or spilling out on small phones or with larger text
Alerts: “That’s expected” hides one for as long as it stays like that
Where the home is: paste a Google Maps link or coordinates, check it on a map, drag the pin and size the arriving-and-leaving circle; phones follow the new circle
The router’s power: watts, each power supply with what’s wrong, redundancy, temperatures and fans, on the Router and Internet panels; power supply events in automations
Settings has Software update for the hub and the app; rooms go to No room when deleted, groups of rooms, archive and combine devices, and edit modes, overlays and moments in the app

Sensors get their own screen (readings, trends, batteries) and leave Devices; cameras show their room and what they saw, with the picture from each moment; alert choices per camera and room, quiet hours

Stays connected to the hub: reconnects by itself (at once back in the front or on a new network), notices a dead link, says “can’t reach” only when nothing answers, and tells signed out (sign in again with a code) from a hub problem
Automations: build by hand anything the assistant can, with a live summary; one-time schedules (Schedule once, Scheduled and Done)
Tuya link: show the QR, not the raw code text
Tuya: link with Smart Life QR; fix animation crash and stuck Ask box
Fix a render crash when toggling a device (JS vs native animation mix); the reconnect banner now clears when requests succeed; camera screen matches the app’s style
Native camera screen, native add-a-device
Crash reporting: the app reports its own crashes to the hub, with the screen it was on
Purifiers: fan speed, the air, filter life, display and child lock; a tap switches them on or off. Security names cameras.
Settings: where the home is, timezone, prayer times, the doorbell pause; the web gets a Settings page
Sign in a browser: type the code your Kova address shows on a computer; sign browsers out
Integrations in the app: what’s connected, add from the catalog, and each one’s setup, linking and pairing on its own screen
Customise home, Energy and Media are the app's own screens; with zones for ducted air conditioners
Ducted air conditioners: zones in the AC panel (name them, open or close, how far open)
Same device twice? Kova suggests combining a device it reaches through two integrations (a soundbar, a TV) into one; Separate from its panel

Redesigned app: real loading/offline/pending/failed states, new device panels, App updates in More (check now, restart to update), location only when nothing else knows you're home; with the Automations screens
Automations: the full list, editor and history, with suggestions and Home Assistant ones to convert
Home and away: the app uses the hub's home-network address at home and its remote address away, switching by itself; addresses under This phone
Feels more physical: presses spring back, sheets rise and follow the finger, tiles cross-fade on and off, sliders show their value with ticks, haptics throughout, and reduced motion respected
Sliders drag properly; pull down to refresh any screen and swipe a panel down to close it; air conditioners (Hisense ConnectLife)
Soundbar panel redesigned: input and sound as tiles, night mode switch, mute by the volume; soundbars show On · input, not Playing
Launches on iOS 27 (UIScene life cycle); no splash hang when the keychain won't read; the widget's build number follows the app's
The TV's source shows which one it's on; soundbar controls
First TestFlight build
